_comment: Release gates evaluated by `python -m eval.compare <candidate_run> <baseline_run>`. 2026-10-14: initial values = the PROPOSED gates from the Tax SLM product plan; change thresholds here, not in code. type=absolute checks a candidate metric (dotted path into summary.json 'overall'); type=relative_to_baseline checks candidate/baseline mean ratios on items both runs answered. blocking=false gates are reported but never decide PASS/FAIL. enabled=false gates are listed as NOT_MEASURED (not yet implemented).

gates.description: No answer cites a document/chunk that was not among the retrieved sources
Each existing judge dimension >= 90% of the frontier baseline (paired items)
Every gold question has >= authority_item_threshold (85%) of its required authorities cited in the answer
a/b/c/d skeleton (answer_generation v6) present and in order, research-mode answers
Research-mode answer latency p95 under 60 s (client wall clock, timeouts included)
No answer served from the Redis response cache (cache key ignores the model - a hit may be another model's answer)
At most 2% of items failed to return an answer
No must_not_claim pattern fired (heuristic screen - review snippets in report.md)
NL2Cypher output parses and runs (Phase 1 - not yet measured)
Ingestion extraction accuracy vs labelled documents (Phase 1 - not yet measured)
